rule: docs/GM-SUBJECT-WORLDS.md §5: swapping a cover's caption to an unrelated subject must change the grammar and at least two motifs, and the swap must be rejected. `mark` is the single canonical noun for each motif; the machine check proves the three covers' mark sets are pairwise disjoint. The verdicts are a written judgement against the shipped pixels (vision pass in audit/cp012-covers/vision.json).

covers.title: Japanese affection and register — a Sample L0 classroom

motifs.name: paper lantern
motifs.encodes: the district the lesson is set in
motifs.must_never_become: a skin on a non-language course; a carrier of kanji-like marks

motifs.name: noren panel with three slits
motifs.encodes: the threshold of entering — the L0 social frame

motifs.name: two counter stools
motifs.encodes: the ordering situation the dialogue happens in

motifs.name: cup with steam
motifs.must_never_become: a product shot or a menu

swaps.reason: A lantern, a noren and two café stools cannot caption a document-inspection course; the grammar and every motif would have to change.
Nothing on this plate is a kitchen implement; a jug and a bowl cannot be read here, and the plum accent of the parent world is absent.
The café counter and the cup do not become a bench and a banneton; only the warm palette survives, which is exactly the failure the check names.

motifs.name: blank measuring jug
motifs.encodes: the vessel the learner reads in task 1
motifs.must_never_become: graduated marks, a scale readout or a recipe quantity

motifs.name: mixing bowl with wooden spoon
motifs.encodes: the making the parent and child do together
motifs.must_never_become: a styled product still life with a brand

motifs.name: two oranges and folded plum linen
motifs.encodes: the fruit drink of the learner page; the parent-world accent
motifs.must_never_become: a finished dish presented as a tested result

motifs.name: kitchen table edge
motifs.encodes: the home bench and its scale
motifs.must_never_become: a café counter or a workshop bench

swaps.reason: A jug and a mixing bowl do not become a lantern and a noren; the plate carries no threshold and no street.
There is no manual, no parcel and no paper stack here; the bench edge alone cannot carry a document course.
No vehicle, no lift, no tool wall and no gasket ring; a kitchen still life is not a service bay at any palette.

covers.title: Technical demo: reading a pack before you install it

motifs.name: open manual with blank pages and ink spine
motifs.encodes: the manifest as the authority you read first
motifs.must_never_become: readable procedure text, a table of values or a page of steps

motifs.name: sealed paper pack with a blank face
motifs.encodes: the pack as a closed object whose claims you inspect
motifs.must_never_become: a printed label, a barcode or a version number

motifs.name: stack of blank sheets
motifs.must_never_become: a checklist of ticked items or a completion claim

motifs.name: bench edge
motifs.must_never_become: a kitchen table or a café counter

swaps.reason: A blank manual and a sealed parcel cannot read as a jug and a bowl; no kitchen vessel or fruit is on the plate.
No lantern, no noren and no café threshold; the plate would have to be redrawn, not recaptioned.
A stack of sheets is not a banneton and a parcel is not a dough dome; only the cream paper survives the swap.

out_of_scope_note: The four demo course covers are not drawn on this card; they come from the product's own world pipeline (CP-015/CP-016) and must pass this same check there.
